title: BetterDrillPickaxes
description: BetterDrillPickaxes! Adds drill pickaxes that are completely customizable, for example a diamond 3x3 drill, a wooden 5x5 drill or something else!
body:
**BetterDrillPickaxes**

The drill plugin of your dreams! Installing this plugin to your server will give you access to a new command, with this command you can give yourself a drill pickaxe.

The drill pickaxe is a pickaxe that can mine bigger areas than a vanilla minecraft pickaxe, 3x3 or 5x5 areas for example. The plugin supports 2x2-10x10 areas, we will change this in a future update where you can change the limit in the config file.

**Commands:**
OP command:
/drill <pickaxe or shovel> <material> <give or remove> <area> <player>

**Pickaxe or shovel:** 
For the second option of the basic command, you choose if you want a pickaxe drill or a shovel drill. The pickaxe drill works on blocks like stone, diamond ore and more, not on dirt. The shovel drill works on blocks like dirt, gravel and more.

**Material:** 
For the third option of the /drill command, you choose your material. Here is the material list: wood, stone, copper, gold, iron, diamond, netherite.

**Give or remove:** 
For the fourth option, you choose if you want to give a drill to a player or remove a drill from a player. The remove option is pretty complicated, you have to choose the exact options of the drill you want to remove.

**Area size:** 
For the fifth option, you choose the size of the area the drill can mine/dig. You can choose between the numbers 2-10. This means that if you choose "5" for example, it will mine a 5x5 area.

**Player:** 
This is the sixth option, choose which player you want to give or remove a drill from.

**Permissions:**
betterdrillpickaxe.admin

This permission gives a player access to use all the plugins commands. 

More permissions will be added in the future.
